svg.title: ARU businesses and services
svg.desc: American Resource Utility, Inc. — Taylor, Wyoming — Provides rail, truck, terminal, and warehouse services for industrial customers.; Blood, Sweat & Tears Railway Company — Taylor, Wyoming — Hauls industrial freight by rail between Wamsutter and Taylor.; Terminal operations — Taylor and Rawlins, Wyoming — Transfers bulk materials between trains, trucks, and storage.; Trucking — Taylor and Rawlins, Wyoming — Hauls bulk materials, industrial supplies, and heavy equipment by road.; Warehousing — Taylor and Rawlins, Wyoming — Stores customer inventory and picks and dispatches orders.; ARU corporate services — Taylor, Wyoming — Handles finance, personnel, customer service, and administration.
